options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: Logic Difficulty
options.doc:
What the logic expects of you.

Hard - Only the tools a location can't be reached without, nothing extra for comfort.
Shop expects you to sell about 85% of accessible ore.

Normal - Also a pickaxe tier or two in heavy digging, some armor in hazard areas, Armor x2 for the final boss.
Shop expects you to sell about 65% of accessible ore.

Easy - About one tier more of the same tools, armor in every hazard area, a water tank in Fire Temple, and you start with a working lamp.
Shop expects you to tell about 50% of accessible ore.

options.name: Tricks
options.doc:
Puts movement tricks and sequence breaks in logic.
Hook jumps, bomb and grenade jumps, several face switches in one climb, digging with Deathplosions, and any jump that needs precise timing.
options.doc_fr:
Mettre les tours de mouvement et la séquence casse dans la logique.
Sauts à crochet, sauts à bombe et à grenade, plusieurs interrupteurs de visage dans une montée, creuser avec Deathplosions, et tout saut qui nécessite un timing précis.

options.name: Shop Price Percent
options.doc:
Shop prices as a percentage of vanilla.
Money bundles are scaled the same way.
options.doc_fr:
Prix de magasin en pourcentage de vanille.
Les paquets d'argent sont répartis de la même façon.

options.name: Show Shop Items
options.doc: Shows each shop slot's item and who it is for.
options.doc_fr: Montre l'objet de chaque machine à sous de magasin et qui il est pour.

options.name: Teleporter Locations
options.doc: Unlocking each of the 25 teleporters (all but El Machino's) is a location. Fast travel still unlocks as usual.

options.name: Hell Cave Locations
options.doc:
Adds the Trials (the hell caves) and their Proof of Completion. Their door needs the Sigillum Caelum et Infernum,
which is only in the pool when this is on.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute les essais (les grottes de l'enfer) et leur preuve d'achèvement. Leur porte a besoin du Sigillum Caelum et Infernum, qui est seulement dans la piscine quand il est allumé.

options.name: Sprint Hydraulics
options.doc:
Where the Sprint Hydraulics are. 
Almost everything needs them. Until they arrive you have only the Temple's first few checks.

Shuffled - Anywhere in the multiworld.

Vanilla - On their podium in the Temple of Guidance.

options.name: Cog Amount
options.doc:
How many Upgrade Cogs are in the pool. Logic never asks for more than 4.
Cogs will only fill up to the number of locations available to them.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de Cogs de mise à niveau sont dans la piscine. Logic ne demande jamais plus de 4.
Cogs ne remplira que le nombre d'emplacements disponibles.
